english.title: Cause use of a vehicle fitted with low visibility additional side marker lamp
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), fitted with an additional side marker lamp in accordance with regulation 22 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989 which was not of such intensity that it was visible from a reasonable distance.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 22(3) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused use of vehicle on road fitted with additional side marker lamp
not of an intensity to be visible from reasonable distance

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H2611 and H3095.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) when the vehicle was fitted with an additional side marker lamp which was not plainly visible at a reasonable distance.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale (level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
